name: Dumbbell Upper / Lower
description: Four days a week for 10 weeks with dumbbells and a bench: two upper-body and two lower-body workouts, each muscle trained twice a week. Single-leg exercises and slow lowering make light dumbbells work hard for the legs. Week 5 is a deload. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Three sets of ten to fifteen

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Four sets on the main exercises, heavier
